notes.title: Obilia 0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Greetings Obilians![/i]

Today we are going to push our weekly update. Patch 0.1.3 will contain several bug fixes and gameplay improvements. Our weekly Community Update video Episode 3 is also can seen at the bottom of this article. 

You can read the patch notes below and watch what happened this week in Obilia. Before we hop into patch notes we want to remind that we are looking forward to hear more from our community. 

[i]Let's shape Obilia's future together. See you next time![/i]

[b]Patch Notes for version 0.1.3[/b]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Fixed issue where first quest enemies does not spawn properly
- NPC systems improved and interaction issues fixed
- Three salmon fish quest issues fixed
- Interaction issues on canoe and water fixed
- Issues where selling the items to merchants fixed. (They have money now)
- Fixed bug where enemies spawning underground

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- AI stats are updated
- Cook and Craft stations revised
- Main sword's shaders are updated
- Idle animations and shape system added for Roamer
- Items are not purchasable in merchants are removed
- Items and their merchant values are updated

[previewyoutube=RXMJBA6QTS8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Obilia 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Hi travelers,[/i]

Our update number 0.1.2.3 is going live soon. This update mainly focuses on performance issues and optimization. As a result we are hoping to see a boost on everyone's FPS. We are also continuing our weekly community videos. You can take a look at the video below and see what happened this week in Obilia.

Let's take a look the main changes in this update,

[b]Gameplay[/b]

- Roamer's textures and animations updated

[b]UI / Misc[/b]

- We have made several updates on optimization and it should boost the frames for all
- More customizable options added under video/graphics settings
- Our game icon updated and has fresh look

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Gliding and its animations now should work properly without stuck

We want to thank everyone for joining our journey and we are looking forward to hearing more feedback from you. We have also linked our official Discord server and Steam discussion board below.

[url=steamcommunity.com/app/2856590/discussions/]Obilia Steam Discussions[/url]
[url=discord.gg/playobilia]Obilia Official Discord[/url]

Have fun everyone!

[previewyoutube=TM2MRmisSMs;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Obilia 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Dear Obilians,[/i]

This week we are pushing our update a bit earlier than planned to address some bugs and gameplay improvements.

Let's take a look patch notes:

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] We have improved the combat camera and now it should feel much more comfortable
[*] Jumping has now better gravitiy (This was requested by b.loonix, thank you for heads up!)
[*] We have made slight visual changes on Whaka
[*] Roamer's textures also improved
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Version number can be seen through game UI
[*] Graphics quality change in settings has now better reflection in game and performance
[/list]

We want to thank everyone and their contributions in the community. While we are working on the next content update, this is also being small update to improve gameplay experience for all and we are looking forward to hear how it rolls out for you!

To keep updated and help us with shaping Obilia's future, you can join our Discord or contribute to our threads in discussions sections. Both will linked below.

[i]Until then, see you with the next update![/i]

[url=steamcommunity.com/app/2856590/discussions/]Obilia Steam Discussions[/url]
[url=discord.gg/playobilia]Obilia Official Discord[/url]

notes.title: Obilia 0.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[i]Dear Obilians,[/i]

Today we are pushing a hotfix patch to solve some of the issues that have been disrupting the gameplay. While we are working on the next update, we want to make sure that all Obilians are comfortable with exploring the lands of Obilia.

The latest updates in the game includes:

[b]Gameplay[/b]

* Mouse invert y axis is now working as intended
* In-game mouse sensitivity is improved
* In-game camera is adjusted (we are continuously reading your feedbacks to find the best tune)
* Glider now has two seconds cooldown and cannot be spammed
* Fixed bug where canoe camera has reversed axis
* The characters Desmond and Sidney have minor design updates. (They got their eyes back, thank you @naecho for letting us know!)

[b]UI[/b]

* Character portraits are updated
* Motion blur toggle is added to the settings (Thank you @zolointo!)

We would like to express our heartfelt thanks for all the feedback that has come from early Obilians and look forward to working on the necessary adjustments to change the gameplay for you all. We have much more in store, and as we continue to work hard, we hope all our community members enjoy exploring Obilia!

[previewyoutube=XxQ0oS1-6uY;full][/previewyoutube]
